name: us030-cred-ceremony-reports
description: 030 FR-038, C6.4-C6.6: config --json with a declared, failing JIRA_PAT_COMMAND. The ceremony still completes degraded (exit 0) — refusing here would deny the operator the very file in which they declare their settings. The C3.x reason appears on stderr and in the personal-config-creation.md degraded detail (asserted per-port in test_config_degraded.bats / Config.Degraded.Tests.ps1); this scenario proves stdout/exit/calls.log/workdir stay byte-identical across ports. The companion case — nothing declared, rung silent — is already covered by us2-degraded-mode.
